formal_statement: ∀ (m N : ℕ) (G : PEqualNP.Expanders.BipGraph m N) (π : List (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.LinClause (Fin m × Fin N))), PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsLinRefutation (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.PHP m N) π → ∃ π' : List (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.LinClause (PEqualNP.Expanders.GEdge G)), PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsLinRefutation (PEqualNP.Expanders.graphPHP G) π' ∧ π'.length ≤ 2 * π.length
plain_statement: For any bipartite graph G on m pigeons and N holes, a Res(+) refutation of PHP m N of length S gives a Res(+) refutation of the pigeonhole formula on G, over the edge variables only, of length at most 2S: set the non-edges to false (L-pcx-045) and rename the remaining variables to edges. Closes the chain gap the red team found: after restriction the variable count in L-pcx-042 must be the number of edges. Link of L-pcx-017.
title: Re-typing: a Res(+) refutation of the pigeonhole formula gives one of the pigeonhole formula on any bipartite graph, at most twice as long
